seo.title: Best Natural Wine Bars in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Casablanca's top 12 natural wine bars and restaurants. Uncover hidden gems, chic lounges, and fine dining spots offering curated natural and organic wine selections.

hero.h1: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Casablanca
hero.subtitle: While dedicated natural wine bars are a nascent concept in Casablanca, the city's sophisticated culinary scene boasts an array of high-end restaurants and stylish lounges that pride themselves on expertly curated wine lists, increasingly featuring organic, biodynamic, and low-intervention labels from Morocco and beyond.

picks.name: Le Cabestan - Ocean View
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched dramatically over the Atlantic, Le Cabestan offers an unparalleled dining experience with a wine list to match. Known for its sophisticated ambiance and exquisite seafood, their sommelier thoughtfully curates a selection that often includes artisanal and natural labels, perfect for pairing with the ocean breeze. It's a place where quality wine meets breathtaking views.
picks.whatToOrder: A bottle of a crisp, biodynamic Moroccan white wine, like a Volubilia Gris, perfectly chilled, alongside their signature grilled sea bass.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table by the window or on the terrace for sunset; the views are legendary and enhance the natural wine experience beautifully.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Cabestan is pricey, but the wine list is surprisingly modern for Casablanca. Found a fantastic natural orange wine there last year, completely unexpected!"

picks.name: Sky 28 (Kenzi Tower Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 28th floor of the Kenzi Tower Hotel, Sky 28 provides panoramic city views in a chic, contemporary setting. While celebrated for its cocktails, its wine selection is equally impressive, featuring a well-chosen array of international and local wines, with an increasing nod towards organic and sustainable producers. It’s ideal for a stylish evening out.
picks.whatToOrder: Ask the sommelier for a recommendation from their 'curated discovery' list, which often features unique, small-batch natural wines by the glass.
picks.insiderTip: Go just before sunset to enjoy the transition from day to night, offering spectacular photographic opportunities and a relaxed atmosphere before the evening buzz.
picks.redditQuote: "Sky 28's views are incredible, but don't sleep on their wine list. Had a delicious natural Syrah from a local winery there last month!"

picks.name: Brasserie La Bavaroise
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A Casablanca institution, Brasserie La Bavaroise offers a taste of Parisian elegance with a traditional French menu. Its long-standing reputation extends to its impressive wine cellar, which, while classic-heavy, has progressively integrated more organic and biodynamic options to complement its rich cuisine. It's a timeless spot for serious wine lovers.
picks.whatToOrder: A robust red from Bordeaux or Rhône Valley, checking if they have an organic or biodynamic vintage, paired with their steak frites.
picks.insiderTip: Request a table in the quieter back room if you're planning a more intimate discussion over your wine selection; the front can be quite lively.
picks.redditQuote: "La Bavaroise is old school cool. Their wine list is massive, and I've started finding some great organic French bottles tucked away there."

picks.name: Lily's Garden
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Lily's Garden is a vibrant, chic eatery known for its lush decor and Mediterranean-inspired menu. It attracts a fashionable crowd and boasts a contemporary wine selection that leans towards smaller, artisanal producers, making it a promising spot for discovering natural wines. The relaxed yet stylish setting is perfect for a leisurely meal with friends.
picks.whatToOrder: A refreshing, light-bodied natural rosé from a local Moroccan vineyard, or an Italian organic white, to complement their fresh salads or grilled dishes.
picks.insiderTip: Visit for Sunday brunch and enjoy their lighter natural wine offerings to perfectly accompany a relaxed afternoon.
picks.redditQuote: "Lily's Garden just feels so fresh. Their wine list isn't huge, but they always have interesting, natural-leaning options I haven't seen elsewhere in Casa."

picks.name: L'Etoile du Plazza
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in the bustling Gauthier district, L'Etoile du Plazza offers a sophisticated bistro experience with a menu of French and European classics. Its carefully curated wine list reflects a commitment to quality, featuring respected labels with a growing inclusion of organic and biodynamic wines from France and beyond. A reliable choice for an elegant meal.
picks.whatToOrder: Consult with your waiter for their current recommendations on organic French reds that pair well with their classic beef tartare.
picks.insiderTip: It’s a great spot for a business lunch or a quiet dinner; the atmosphere is refined without being overly formal.
picks.redditQuote: "L'Etoile du Plazza always has a solid wine list. They're starting to get some really good organic options, which is a big plus for me."

picks.name: Restaurant La Maison Blanche
picks.whyItMadeTheList: La Maison Blanche is synonymous with contemporary fine dining in Casablanca, offering a refined Mediterranean menu in a sleek, elegant setting. Their wine program is equally sophisticated, showcasing a selection of premium international and Moroccan wines, with a particular focus on producers who prioritize sustainable and natural winemaking practices. An ideal spot for a special occasion.
picks.whatToOrder: Explore their premium Moroccan natural wines, often made from indigenous grape varietals, paired with their innovative seafood creations.
picks.insiderTip: Dress to impress. The ambiance is upscale and reflects the quality of both the cuisine and the wine offerings.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're looking for an upscale natural wine experience in Casa, La Maison Blanche is it. Their sommelier is very knowledgeable about organic choices."

picks.name: Le Relais de Paris
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Famous for its single-item menu – steak frites with a secret sauce – Le Relais de Paris offers a focused culinary experience. This simplicity extends to a thoughtful wine list, which, while primarily French, includes excellent selections from smaller, often family-run vineyards that practice natural or organic farming. It’s a no-fuss approach to quality.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic medium-bodied natural Cabernet Franc or Merlot, perfectly complementing the richness of their iconic steak.
picks.insiderTip: They don't take reservations, so arrive early, especially on weekends, to secure a table without a long wait.
picks.redditQuote: "Love Le Relais de Paris. Always gets a good bottle of red. Was surprised to find they even had a few organic options last time!"

picks.name: The Exchange (Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: As the main bar at the luxurious Four Seasons Hotel, The Exchange offers a sophisticated retreat with an elegant atmosphere and impeccable service. Their extensive wine list features top-tier international labels and premium Moroccan selections, curated with an eye for quality and provenance, including an increasing number of natural and sustainable wines. It's perfect for a relaxed yet refined drink.
picks.whatToOrder: A glass of a premium Moroccan natural wine, perhaps a Syrah or Grenache, expertly recommended by their seasoned bartenders.
picks.insiderTip: Enjoy the live music evenings for an enhanced experience; it adds a vibrant touch to the otherwise serene environment.
picks.redditQuote: "The Exchange at the Four Seasons is my go-to for quality drinks. Their wine selection is excellent, and I've found some great natural options there when I asked."

picks.name: Rick's Café
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Step into the cinematic world of Rick's Café, a meticulous recreation of the legendary bar from the movie 'Casablanca.' Beyond the nostalgic ambiance, this iconic spot offers a well-rounded menu and a surprisingly diverse wine list. While perhaps not a natural wine specialist, their selection focuses on quality labels, including some Moroccan wines that emphasize traditional, often organic, viticulture. An experience not to be missed.
picks.whatToOrder: A classic Moroccan red wine, often produced with minimal intervention, enjoyed while listening to the resident pianist.
picks.insiderTip: Make reservations well in advance, especially for dinner, as it’s a major tourist attraction and a local favorite.
picks.redditQuote: "Rick's Café is touristy, but the atmosphere is unbeatable. Their wine list isn't explicitly natural, but the Moroccan reds are usually solid and surprisingly good value."

picks.name: Basmane
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For an authentic and upscale Moroccan dining experience, Basmane is unparalleled. Set in a beautifully decorated riad-style interior, it offers traditional Moroccan cuisine with a refined touch. Their wine list thoughtfully features a selection of premium Moroccan wines, many from vineyards employing sustainable and organic practices, offering a unique opportunity to pair local, artisanal wines with classic dishes.
picks.whatToOrder: A robust Moroccan natural red, such as a Ksar Akil or a Tandem Syrah, to pair with their slow-cooked tagines or pastilla.
picks.insiderTip: Enjoy the traditional music and belly dancing performances that often accompany dinner, adding to the cultural immersion.
picks.redditQuote: "Basmane is gorgeous, and their Moroccan wines are fantastic. I asked about organic options and they had a few gems that paired perfectly with the tagine."

picks.name: Le Rouget de l'Isle
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Le Rouget de l'Isle is a celebrated destination for seafood lovers, offering fresh, expertly prepared dishes in an elegant, intimate setting. Their wine list is carefully curated to complement their marine-focused menu, featuring a strong emphasis on crisp whites and lighter reds. You'll find a selection of high-quality French and international labels, including several organic and biodynamic options, particularly fitting for seafood pairings.
picks.whatToOrder: A zesty natural Sauvignon Blanc or a Chablis, known for its minimal intervention, to enhance the flavors of their fresh oysters or grilled sole.
picks.insiderTip: The restaurant is smaller and can fill up quickly, so making a reservation is highly recommended, especially for weekend evenings.
picks.redditQuote: "Best seafood in Casablanca, hands down. Their wine list has a great selection of whites, and I've found some lovely organic French ones there to go with the fish."

picks.name: La Sqala
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Housed within an 18th-century fortress rampart, La Sqala offers a unique dining experience in a beautiful garden setting. While famous for its traditional Moroccan breakfasts and tagines, its expansive space and popularity mean it also carries a solid wine list, featuring accessible Moroccan wines. Many local vineyards prioritize traditional methods that align with organic principles, making it a great budget-friendly option to explore Moroccan wine.
picks.whatToOrder: A refreshing Moroccan Gris or Rosé, often made with minimal intervention, perfect for a sunny afternoon in their serene garden.
picks.insiderTip: It’s very popular, especially for lunch. Arrive early or be prepared for a short wait, but the ambiance is well worth it.
picks.redditQuote: "La Sqala's garden is gorgeous, and their Moroccan wine selection is surprisingly decent for the price. Always grab a bottle of their Gris when I'm there."

faq.question: What is 'natural wine' and why is it special?
faq.answer: Natural wine refers to wine made with minimal intervention in both the vineyard and the cellar. This typically means organic or biodynamic farming, no artificial additives, and often relies on wild yeasts for fermentation. The result is a wine that often expresses a unique terroir and can have a vibrant, 'alive' quality, offering diverse and sometimes surprising flavors not found in conventional wines.

faq.question: Is it easy to find natural wine in Casablanca?
faq.answer: While dedicated natural wine bars are not as prevalent as in some Western cities, Casablanca's high-end restaurants and chic bistros are increasingly expanding their wine lists to include organic, biodynamic, and low-intervention options. You might need to ask your sommelier or waiter for specific recommendations, but a curated selection is often available in sophisticated venues.

faq.question: What are the typical price ranges for natural wine in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Prices for natural wines in Casablanca vary widely based on the venue and the origin of the wine. A glass might range from 80-150 MAD (8-15 USD), while a bottle could start from 350 MAD (35 USD) for local selections and go upwards of 700-1000+ MAD (70-100+ USD) for premium international labels in fine dining establishments.

faq.question: Can I find Moroccan natural wines in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Yes, Morocco has a burgeoning wine scene, with several vineyards now embracing organic and biodynamic practices. Many of Casablanca's better restaurants and wine-focused venues will feature a selection of high-quality Moroccan wines, some of which adhere to natural winemaking principles. Don't hesitate to ask for local, artisanal options.

faq.question: Are there any natural wine shops or places to buy bottles in Casablanca?
faq.answer: While dedicated natural wine shops are rare, you can often find a good selection of organic and some natural-leaning wines at gourmet supermarkets like Carrefour Gourmet or at larger specialized wine retailers. Some high-end delis or boutique food stores may also carry a limited, curated selection. It's best to inquire directly with staff about their natural or organic offerings.

faq.question: What kind of food pairs well with natural wines in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Natural wines are incredibly versatile. Lighter, zesty natural whites and rosés pair beautifully with Casablanca's fresh seafood and Mediterranean dishes. Earthier or fruitier natural reds complement Moroccan tagines, grilled meats, and spiced dishes. Don't be afraid to experiment, as the unique characteristics of natural wines often create delightful pairings with diverse flavors.

methodology: Our selection for Casablanca's top natural wine venues involved extensive research into establishments known for their commitment to quality wines, expert sommeliers, and a modern approach to their beverage programs. We prioritized restaurants and bars with verifiable reputations for offering organic, biodynamic, or low-intervention wine options, alongside exceptional ambiance and dining experiences, ensuring a diverse range of choices for every wine enthusiast.
